message.content: {"summary":"You delivered an outstanding preliminary report that achieved full marks across all rubric criteria. Your mission concept for coral bleaching monitoring is exceptionally well-justified and linked to end users. Furthermore, your project planning includes thorough risk mitigations, your preliminary orbital analysis shows robust engineering progress, and the presentation is professional and meticulously referenced.","next_steps":["Translate your candidate 600 km SSO orbit into complete STK mission simulations to model full reef revisit and coverage times.","Advance your preliminary payload analysis by sizing sensor optics and data downlinks to match the identified swath and resolution needs.","Maintain this high standard of technical rigour, professional layout, and thorough literature referencing as you draft the final report."],"criteria":{"C1":"You achieved the Accomplished level by clearly establishing mission goals, quantified objectives, and traceable requirements linked directly to key stakeholders (AIMS, GBRMPA, CSIRO, BoM) in the 'Mission Concept & Rationale' section. To maintain this high standard, continue referencing literature to justify any operational mission adjustments.","C2":"Your project plan reached the Accomplished tier through a robust Gantt chart, explicit software plans, and an excellent risk and contingency matrix (Table 1) tied to technical trade-offs. To sustain this, continue documenting how schedule adaptations and contingencies are executed as technical complexities evolve.","C3":"You met the Accomplished standard by providing rigorous preliminary engineering work in Table 3, combining hand calculations with STK cross-validation and interpreting sensor swath against reef geometry. To build on this in future submissions, integrate these preliminary orbital parameters into comprehensive mission lifetime and coverage simulations.","C4":"You attained the Accomplished level with an impeccably structured, easy-to-read report featuring professional formatting, well-captioned figures and tables (such as Figure 1), and accurate IEEE citations. To sustain this grade, maintain consistent referencing and professional document design across all forthcoming project deliverables."}}
